verdict.rationale: Docs show KYC/KYB verification with watchlist checks (implying sanctions screening) and a general claim of centralized operational tooling with bank-partner collaboration, suggesting some duty-split framework exists. However, there is no explicit evidence of transaction monitoring, alert case management, or SAR-filing support tooling. missing for 10: transaction monitoring tooling, case management for alerts, SAR-filing support, explicit description of duty split between ops/platform/bank for compliance workflows.
